rows.notes: [T032] installed 30 GWh/yr as of 2026-03-11: Jinan municipal government (English site) states the base has 'an annual production capacity of 30 gigawatt hours' and presents it as the producer of BYD's second-generation flash-charging blade cells (title; producing inferred from title + capacity wording, the page gives no per-phase commissioning dates). installed basis: government (built design capacity; may run ~20% above company effective capacity). Equals the v2 nameplate 30 (two 15 GWh phases per v1 timeline, 2022 and Feb 2023, not re-confirmed here), so no unbuilt phase remains; nameplate and ref_year unchanged. Confidence raised 0.5 -> 0.7 because a government source now states the 30 GWh as built capacity.

[T032] installed 30 GWh/yr as of 2026-04-21: Sina Finance (2026-04-21) 'currently the Xiamen base has 30 GWh built and in production' (phases 1-2 plus phase 3 stage 1, consistent with 10+10+10). installed basis: press (apparently relaying company/Xiamen project information). Phase 3 stage 2 (20 GWh, 5 lines) was in trial production in April 2026 with formal start expected May 2026 (same article; EnergyTrend 2026-04-21 says the same) and is NOT counted; stage 3 (10 GWh) under construction, production expected 2027-03. Nameplate 60 / ref_year 2027 unchanged. CONFLICT: a 2026-09-05 10jqka article says CALB is 'building a 70GWh base' in Xiamen (https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20260905/c679625562.shtml, no phase detail) vs 60 GWh (Xiamen DRC via MarkLines/OFweek, Feb 2025); not resolved here, nameplate left at 60. capacity_by_year_json (v1 reported {2023:10, 2027:60}) left as is; 2023:10 is inconsistent with 30 built and should be reviewed by the lead.

[T032] installed 20 GWh/yr: Sina Finance 2026-01-29: 'total planned capacity 40GWh, investment RMB15bn, of which phase 1 20GWh capacity has gone into production in 2023' (the 2026-02-04 Sina roundup used by T004 says the same without the GWh figure). installed_as_of = article date (no later commissioning event found; capacity stated as in production). installed basis: press (company-capacity roundup). Phase 2 (20 GWh) undated; no 2025-26 news of phase 2 found; nameplate 40 / ref_year 2026 (fallback) unchanged. capacity_by_year_json now {2023:20} confirmed by this source (v1 reported value restored by T031 is now backed). The 2026-06-16 roundup's '20GWh' for Meishan is phase 1 only.

[T032] installed 15 GWh/yr (phase 1) as of 2024-02-02: CnEVPost relaying the FAW-FinDreams statement - the plant 'went into production on February 2' (2024) with 'initial production capacity 15 GWh'; total plan 45 GWh. installed basis: company statement via press. start_year set to 2024 (production start; v1 2023 was the July 2023 first-pack trial). Figure is older than 18 months, so confidence capped at 0.5 (D-015) although the plant is 45 GWh (G4 will flag: ESCALATE, needs a 2025-26 company or Changchun government statement). A 2026-05-09 Eastmoney piece (caifuhao.eastmoney.com/news/20260509164923372581040) repeats 2024-02-02 start and 45 GWh (3x15) plan but gives no current output; its title only 'hopes' phase 2 will make 2nd-gen blade cells, so phase 2 not counted. Nameplate 45 / ref_year 2024 unchanged (phases 2-3 undated).

[T032] installed 10 GWh/yr as of 2023-02-03: Hunan provincial industry department (reprint of Hunan Daily 2023-02-03): factory 'put into production end-2020 ... capable of 10 GWh/yr lithium-ion cells', 'phase-1 lines basically at full output, phase 2 under construction'. installed basis: government. Figure is >18 months old -> confidence <=0.5 (D-015); phase 2 (second 10 GWh, nameplate 20 from a weak Xueqiu post, not re-confirmed) may be online since; no 2025-26 source found. start_year changed 2021 -> 2020 (end-2020 production per S5). v1 reported ramp {2021:10, 2022:20} replaced by {2023:10}: it contradicted S5 (phase 2 still under construction Feb 2023). The 19 GWh Changsha line (EIA 2025, EnergyTrend/SMM) is PACK, excluded. Nameplate 20 / ref_year 2025 unchanged; ESCALATE: 20 GWh nameplate rests on a single weak aggregator, large plant below 0.6.

[T032] installed 35 GWh/yr as of 2023-11-20, REPORTED tier: Chongqing Daily e-paper 2023-11-20 (PDF >10 MB, not fetchable here) - text 'in 2020 FinDreams implemented a 15 GWh expansion, forming 35 GWh power-battery production capacity' was seen only in a web-search result summary of that PDF. installed basis: press (local newspaper). Consistent with v1/T003 phases (phase 1 20 GWh 2020 + phase 2 15 GWh 2022, Bishan gov page bishan.gov.cn/sy_241/ywdt/202307/t20230731_12197812.html returned 503). Status operational: Sina Finance 2026-07-17 (S7): 'FinDreams Bishan blade batteries >90% of the city's power-battery market' (year of byline not printed; taken from URL path). Figure >18 months old and reported -> confidence <=0.5. The 20 GWh phase 3 (to 55 GWh, 2022-23 plans) is undated/unconfirmed and not in nameplate 35; nothing found on whether it is built. Nameplate 35 / ref_year 2021 unchanged (stale, flagged by T003).
